key_insight: AI-Donkey combines expert-curated knowledge with deterministic execution to help LLM agents reliably construct complex many-body perturbation theory workflows.
engineering_relevance: The framework could reduce specialist setup effort for first-principles calculations of excited-state properties and electron–phonon interactions in materials.
method: Benchmark out-of-the-box agents on GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT workflow construction.
Combine expert-curated knowledge with deterministic execution to address cross-stage inconsistencies.
Demonstrate autonomous calculations and post-processing for 1D, 2D, and bulk materials.
evidence_signal: Out-of-the-box agents averaged 54%, 36%, and 19% on GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT benchmarks, respectively; with AI-Donkey, all tested agents produced complete, runnable workflows with no observed run-to-run variation.
watch_item: Runnable workflows do not alone establish numerical convergence or physical accuracy; reliability beyond the tested systems and software configurations remains to be established.
paper_title: Enabling large language model agents for high-fidelity many-body perturbation theory calculations
